objs.name: policy
objs.description: A company-wide regulation and process document at strategic level covering topics such as code of conduct, travel expenses, and organizational structure

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process, defining roles, objectives and framework

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A detailed document describing specific procedures and process sequences with responsible persons to achieve an objective

objs.name: document
objs.description: A general artifact subject to creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving in the P&R management system

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary document object that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not require dual control

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document object that is automatically released with the main document and triggers versioning of the main document

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request to amend an existing document without affecting content or version history

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check whether a document requires revision, extension of validity, or invalidation

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document that no longer has validity and must be withdrawn from circulation

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore an invalidated document during the archiving period

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: A specific release state of a document with associated metadata, signatures, and validity period

objs.name: author
objs.description: A person who creates and signs documents and manages change proposals

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A person who has personal change rights on a document in addition to the registered author

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A person who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A person responsible for deciding whether a document is distributed to readers

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A person who translates released content into other languages

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user who views approved documents and can acknowledge receipt

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A user group that retains read access to archived documents

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: A user group permitted to create reactivation requests

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users assigned to specific roles and document authorizations

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to receive document notifications and distribution

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants during the release process

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: A record of all actions, signatures, and status changes for a document

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new information object with selection of document type and optional template

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The category of document being created

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using an editing client based on source format

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic conversion of edited document to PDF format for web display

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Creation or modification of standardized and custom metadata attributes for a document

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of group and person-related authorizations for readers, authors, reviewers, and releasers

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Supplementation of a document with additional information objects that do not require release workflow

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Supplementation of a document with controlled attachment objects subject to release workflow

evts.name: initiate_release
evts.description: Start of the 3-step release workflow by author or co-author

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The current step in the release process: Creator, Review, or Release

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Application of electronic signature by workflow participant during release process

evts.name: complete_review
evts.description: Completion of review task by all assigned reviewers with positive or negative outcome

evts.name: complete_release
evts.description: Completion of release task with approval from at least one assigned releaser

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of document after release making it visible to readers

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of new version of released document with retention and potential adaptation of previous data

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of attachment for archiving when no longer relevant to new document version

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of amendment proposal for document without affecting content or version history

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of new document version to incorporate approved change proposal

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Documentation of completion of assigned change proposal by document author

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Extension of document validity by updating the valid until date

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Creation of request to invalidate document with no additional validity

evts.name: complete_override
evts.description: Declaration of document as out of force with archiving of rights revocation

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Creation of request to re-validate invalidated document by Business Admin Group member

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validation of document with creation of new version and restoration of metadata and attachments

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Automatic email notification to assigned users and user groups upon document release

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow-supported confirmation by recipient that document has been acknowledged

attributes.name: acknowledgement_status
attributes.description: Whether acknowledgement has been confirmed or is pending

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language with workflow approval

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approval and release of translated document version making it visible in target language

o2o.description: A document is composed of multiple versions over its lifecycle
A document contains controlled attachments that are released with the document
A document may be supplemented with additional information objects
A change proposal is clearly associated with a specific document
A validity extension request is linked to a document requiring validity check
An override request is associated with a document to be invalidated
A reactivation request references an invalidated document from a previous override
An author creates and is responsible for documents
Co-authors have personal change rights on documents
Reviewers are assigned to check document content
Releasers are assigned to approve and release documents
Translators create language versions of released documents
User groups are assigned to distribution lists for document notification and access
Readers are members of user groups assigned to documents

o2e.description: A document is created as new information object
Document content is edited and modified
Document is converted to PDF format
Document metadata and properties are maintained
Authorization attributes are assigned to document
Additional information objects are added to document
Attachment objects are added to document
Release workflow is initiated for document
Electronic signature is applied to document version
Review task is completed for document
Release task is completed for document
Document is published after release
New version of released document is created
Attachment is marked for archiving
Change proposal is created for document
Change proposal is implemented in new document version
Change proposal completion is documented
Document validity period is extended
Override request is created for invalidation
Document is invalidated and archived
Reactivation request is created
Document is reactivated from archived state
Document distribution email is sent to distribution list
Reader confirms acknowledgement of document
Document content is translated to another language
Translated document version is released
